gates.name: Metric-level and period-level certification
gates.evidence: 31 live companies; 2,388 source-bound independently checked observations, 179 accounting-certified metric/period observations, 1,535 explicit gap records, 2,463 resolved source IDs. Three conservative substatus refinements reproduced from exact current source payloads and pinned certifier; initial strict FAIL retained. This is selected evidence, not full certification.

gates.name: Historical security identity
gates.evidence: 21 strict dated SEC identity/price joins; exact observed dates only. Final 20-company bounded cohort covers several sectors. Multiple covered classes remain ambiguous; continuous ticker intervals and delisting histories are not inferred.

gates.name: Authorized prices and corporate actions
gates.evidence: Owner-only Alpaca historical prices are integrated for 21 supported point joins. Corporate actions are not integrated: use rights and dated identity/adjustment validity on existing Massive/WRDS collections remain unverified; no licensed migration is enabled. Price-publication times remain unknown.

gates.name: Three substantive calculations independently verified end to end
gates.evidence: 249 live calculations across 20 companies: 58 revenue growth, 56 operating margin, 70 net margin, 65 free cash flow. 498 inputs match independently calculated raw SEC proofs; 20 price tokens equal original recovered decimal projections. Unsupported market cap and EV components remain unavailable.

gates.name: Combined fundamentals and market screen
gates.evidence: 20 explicitly requested companies; 17 verified revenue-growth/price matches. GE/GS/MS have unavailable required revenue inputs; additional price-date gaps are explicit. Measured 33,016,204 bytes, 64 source objects, 30 request-local hits, within 32 MiB. No silent truncation or invented matches.

gates.name: Existing terminal workflow
gates.evidence: 20 companies complete search, overview, annual history, exact-point price chart, valuation, provenance and protected export. 126 workflow checks include the recorded screen renderer replay; an additional real two-company screen verifies the fixed renderer. HD has six live valuation-chart periods; WMT has 252 retrospective provider-symbol price-chart sessions.

gates.name: Historical release reproducibility
gates.evidence: Two approved old SEC releases reproduce exact selected financial-history hashes on final Worker; all three protected production CURRENT pointers remain byte-identical. Original immutable source references are preserved. This is bounded historical verification, not an estate-wide file census.

gates.name: Verified deployment and numerical benchmarks
gates.evidence: Active Worker be4243ee-f3d5-4920-89bd-ad2e06f16ae1, source 1af8cd0, research 358ea45..., SEC B39 unchanged. Final matched 40/40 financial projections equal baseline. Repeated HIT p50 1057.753→679.356 ms and p95 4221.019→1806.804 ms; measured improvements are observational, not causal guarantees. Billing evidence unavailable.
